title: Ondansetron source-to-scored-question author audit
status: Source fact triage performed; clinical and teaching-source completion NOT certified
method: Count only facts required to answer actual scored items; do not award coverage because a detail appears in the stem, wrong options or explanation. Product-specific unlabeled local shelf details must be verified before writing an administration answer key.

facts.rationale: The question requires knowledge of ondansetron's 5-HT3 class.
